hints.title: Encapsulating Mutable Counter State
hints.text: A stateful controller object needs methods to increment, decrement, and restore a private numeric value to its initial configuration.

hints.title: Dual Variable Closure Binding
hints.text: Store both the initial baseline and a mutable current value within the parent function scope so all returned methods share access.

hints.title: Object Method Interface Blueprint
hints.text: Let current = init. Return an object with increment: () => ++current, decrement: () => --current, and reset: () => (current = init).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: State transitions occur in-place within lexical closure.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Global variables cause conflicts between distinct counter instances and violate encapsulation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lexical closure preserves isolated scope per instance with minimal memory footprint.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-increment and pre-decrement semantics returning the updated value after modification.
